conclusions.info_audio: loadInfoPrefs calls checkSoundPref(imode.wav) without assigning movie media or starting an info animation sequence. checkSoundPref only calls theme.playSound if saved soundFX=true. No sound-end callback is present.
conclusions.info_load_visuals: Set view dimensions to minimum413x354 and synchronize eight frame-piece alpha values for the saved palette via htcpStartupInfo, then htcpInfo. Existing static c_back.jpg and mapped c_menu images are immediately present.
conclusions.palette_animation: infoView onTimer=htcpInfo every500ms. It compares shared htcpID with infoStatus and fades all8 pieces of the next palette using htcpTimer(default700ms). Once infoStatus advances, an unchanged palette ID does not repeat that branch. This is palette synchronization, not a timed18s story or automatic page slideshow.
conclusions.page_visual_animation: Only a user menu/prev/next action calls showInfo/infoNavNext/infoNavPrev. Those swap infoSub background to c_sub_MODE_PAGE.jpg at alpha50 then fade to255 over400ms. endAlphaBlend copies final page into menuBack; WebDestinations shows link1 only after completion. Return-to-menu fades infoSub to0 over500ms.
conclusions.main_intro: The sole animated GIF is intro_anim.gif59frames100ms each, on mainView introAnim at53,52; main toggleShutter initially assigns it and plays intro4.wav. No info function references it. An unused colorTimer(intro) branch also assigns it and references absent intro3.wav; no info dependency.
conclusions.video_nodes: Two hidden enabled video nodes belong to controlView/mainView; real videoWin is in videoView for current user media. infoView contains none. The full info code and archive also contain no movie assignment/download.
conclusions.remote_links: Only static browser launchURL targets NeedForSpeed website and Windows XP Extras. SkinsFactory URL is comment metadata; no remote movie/media target is specified.
conclusions.archive_scope: Every supplied archive member matched recovered bytes and recorded CRC. All239 PNG/JPG assets decoded as single-frame PNG/JPEG; soleGIF is59frames. WAVs are PCM RIFF/WAVE. No embedded cinematic/movie asset found. These findings cannot rule out separate historical downloads or other skin editions.
